title: BL-KNT Collision Attribution & Real Application Benchmark Gate
owner_directive: Do not absorb Kevin T.N original systems. Only reverse-direction critique or multi-angle input may be accepted into BL after Bách Lâm explicitly concludes it is useful. Collision-derived products are research objects that require classification, benchmark and audit.

C0.name: KNT_ORIGINAL_SYSTEM
C0.description: Kevin-authored/source-bound original system, paper, repository or formulation. External reference and benchmark target only.

C1.name: KNT_REVERSE_CRITIQUE
C1.description: Kevin critique directed at Bách/BL. May be retained as dissent/correction input without importing Kevin's system.

C2.name: KNT_MULTIANGLE_INPUT
C2.description: Additional perspective that broadens Bách/BL framing. Source attribution stays Kevin.

C3.name: CONVERGENT_INTERSECTION
C3.description: Independent or unresolved overlap. Requires Intersection Index and prior-art state; similarity alone proves no lineage.

C4.name: HYBRID_COLLISION_RESEARCH
C4.description: Hybrid or whole-system research produced through debate/collision. It may sit inside overall BL research with claim-level contribution mapping and audit.

C5.name: DISTINCT_COLLISION_DISCOVERY
C5.description: Separate product discovered through collision and materially distinct from Kevin's original system. Becomes BL research only after explicit Bách acceptance and audit.

C6.name: BL_INDEPENDENT_POST_COLLISION
C6.description: BL derivation after contact with Kevin but claimed independent only when a separate causal path/antecedent is evidenced.

C7.name: CONTESTED_OR_UNKNOWN
C7.description: Insufficient evidence to classify origin/derivation. Preserve contradiction and UNKNOWN.

intersection_index.warning: Intersection Index is not authorship or derivation probability.

real_application_value.rule: No artifact may score above the ceiling supported by its strongest verified application evidence.

promotion_rules.C0: never promote into BL as absorbed system
promotion_rules.C1_C2: may be retained only after explicit Bách conclusion, with Kevin source attribution
promotion_rules.C3: retain as convergence/intersection, no genealogy rewrite
promotion_rules.C4: research and audit inside BL overall program; contribution map mandatory
promotion_rules.C5: requires explicit Bách ACCEPTED_RESEARCH plus prior art, falsifier, RAV and audit
